strings.(자리를 지키고 있던 헤이든이 낯선 기운이 몰려오자 조용히 하늘을 바라본: (Hayden quietly looks up at the sky as unfamiliar presences approach the place she has been watching over.)
strings.오랫동안 섬에 있었지만, 이런 기분은 처음이야. 마리, 손님 오시니까 인: I have been on this island a long time, but I have never felt anything like this. Marie, we have guests. Let us get ready to greet them.
strings.(헤이든이 품에 있던 인형 마리의 머리를 쓰다듬는다. 그러자 마리가 고개: (Hayden strokes Marie’s head. The doll nods and jumps down from her arms.)
strings.처음 뵙겠습니다. 미르라고…. 으아아아아악, 얘 뭐예요?: A pleasure to meet you. My name is Mir... Aaaaaah! What is that?!
Is she not adorable? This is my friend Marie.
You know everyone, Hayden. Only Mir needs an introduction.
strings.(미르가 헤이든 앞에 도착한 정령들의 모습을 확인한다.): (Mir looks over the spirits gathered before Hayden.)
strings.우리는 모를 수가 없어. 눈을 뜨면 자연스레 다 알게 되니까. 가끔 어쩔: We cannot help knowing. When we open our eyes, the knowledge comes naturally. Though there are occasional exceptions.
strings.여기까지 온 기분이 어때요, 나린?: How does it feel to have come all this way, Narin?
strings.…세상에 다른 대륙까지 오게 되는 건 상상도 못했는데, 구름 위를 나는: ...I never imagined visiting another continent. I feel as though I am flying above the clouds.
strings.후후, 그랬지요. 모두 이리스 님과 하르모니아 덕분이옵니다. 다른 대륙으: Hehe, so I did. It is all thanks to Lady Iris and Harmonia. They gave me permission to visit another continent and helped me practice flying.
That scroll of yours... It has been such a long time since I saw it.
strings.(나린이 헤이든을 향해 활짝 웃으며 두루마리를 들어 보인다.): (Narin smiles brightly at Hayden and holds up the scroll.)
strings.헤이든에게 있는 마리와 비슷한 형태지요. 두루마리라 따로 인사를 하지 못: It is much like your Marie, Hayden. A pity it cannot offer its own greeting, being a scroll.
strings.나름 모임인데, 뭐 먹을 거 없나요?: Since we are having a gathering, is there anything to eat?
I brought some food from Gerda, just in case.
strings.좋아요! 게르다의 음식은 실망한 적이 없으니까요. 꺄, 샌드위치!: Wonderful! Gerda’s food has never let me down. Ooh, sandwiches!
strings.그러고 보니 나린은 음식을 먹었죠?: Come to think of it, you eat food too, do you not, Narin?
strings.사람들이 느끼는 깊은 맛까지는 모르지만, 종종 먹는 즐거움을 느끼곤 합니: I cannot appreciate its full flavor as humans do, but I sometimes take pleasure in eating.
strings.생명의 음식을 즐기는 정령이라…. 미르가 있어서 신기하지는 않지만, 그대: A spirit who enjoys the food of living beings... Mir makes that less surprising, but you seem more accustomed to humans than to spirits...
I do not know whether I should thank the vanished Echo for that, but I am content as I am now.
strings.와, 이거 맛있어! 게르다의 음식은 정말 최고예요!: Wow, this is delicious! Gerda’s food really is the best!
The others do not eat, so please have as much as you like.
Mir, I will make you something later. I have been studying cooking quite a bit.
strings.제가 잘못했어요. 적당히 먹을게요. 배고프게 태어난 걸 어떻게 해요. 아: I am sorry! I will not eat too much. What can I do? I was born hungry. Ahh...
My apologies, Mir. I will prepare some fruit next time. And...
strings.기아스, 그건 제가 이야기할게요. 이제 다 모인 건가요?: Geis, let me explain that. Is everyone here now?
One person—no! One spirit is still missing.
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 아이에 섬 안쪽에서 모두가 기다리던 정령이 서둘러: (No sooner are the words spoken than the spirit everyone has been waiting for hurries out from the island’s interior.)
strings.저 안쪽에 점마들 뭐꼬. 개 닮은 새? 새 닮은 개 마족들이 잠자고 있어: What were those things back there? Dog-like birds? Bird-like dogs? Those demons were sleeping, and they gave me a fright. What brought them all the way out here...?
They are considered fools even in the Demon Realm. There is no need to worry about them.
strings.그래도 괘안나?: Are you sure that’s all right?
It is fine. You have my word as the island’s spirit, so do not worry.
We have been waiting for you, Zoe.
strings.처음 보는 아도 있네. 내는 조에. 니도 말씨가 그런 걸 보니 옛날 정령: A new face, too. I’m Zoe. With that way of talking, you must be an old spirit yourself, eh?
I do not know how far back you mean by old, but I have always spoken this way. Hehe.
strings.(그렇게 정령들이 모여 인사를 하고 있을 때, 헤이든의 주위를 맴돌던 마: (As the spirits exchange greetings, Marie, who has been circling Hayden, walks into their midst.)
strings.그래, 마리. 인사는 다 하셨을테니 이제 제 이야기를 들어주세요. 말씀드: Of course. Marie. Now that everyone has said hello, please listen. I asked you to meet here because there is something I need to tell you.
strings.하르모니아, 그대가 들고 있는 목걸이에 대한 이야기인가?: Harmonia, is this about the necklace you are holding?
No. Nor has a new inner world opened.
May I ask who you mean...?
strings.오랫동안 주인을 기다린채 잠이 들지 않았던 빛의 정령이지. 프레이오스 동: A spirit of light who waited long for his master without sleeping. He left his voice in eastern Freios for the sake of its living beings...
strings.금마는 이자껏 어데 있었는데?: Where has he been all this time?
He has been asleep in Orcarium, where he originally belonged.
strings.오르까리움? 거기 괘안치 않나? 모 문젠데?: Orcarium? Isn’t that place all right? What’s the problem?
strings.누군가 그를 강제로 잠들게 했다가 다시 깨웠어요. 그래서 여러분께 부탁을: Someone forced him into sleep, then woke him again. That is why I need your help. It is Lady Iris’s wish as well.
strings.…균열의 틈에서 대지로 흘러내린 검은 달의 기운, 그게 어디로 흩어지는지: ...Find out where the Black Moon’s energy is scattering—the energy that spilled onto the earth through the cracks.
